hints.title: Compute Expected Difference
hints.text: The difference between the last and first elements divided by array length gives the expected progression step.

hints.title: Compare Expected Values Sequentially
hints.text: Traverse the array and verify each index against its expected value starting from the first element.

hints.title: Detect First Discrepancy
hints.text: The missing value is the expected term at the very first index where the actual element deviates from progression.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting or difference frequency histograms take unnecessary extra operations when first and last elements suffice.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear pass identifies the missing value with constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle zero common difference correctly and integer division.
complexity.notes: Common difference diff can be negative or zero.
